It encourages individuals to strive towards excellence in their actions and deeds, as a Noble woman would do. The name Taybah serves as an inspiration for us to be well-received and well-liked in the sight of Allah, and to always strive to be pleasing to Him, as mentioned in Surah Al-An'am, verse 54: "And the righteous will be in gardens and rivers, in a seat for them of truth, and they will not be removed therefrom.
